goal: Generate a main visual for a sports brand featuring a fictional tall male basketball player, with strong lighting and impactful copy, avoiding specific product SKUs to prevent misleading details.

visual_tone.aesthetic: high-energy portrait blending street and competition
visual_tone.color_palette: Black + sideline gray + fluorescent orange accents
visual_tone.lighting: Side top hard light creating a sense of muscle volume, with fine dust particles in the air

centerpiece.description: A fictional tall male basketball player around 30 years old (strong arms, dark short hair with headband) in a half-body shot, realistic texture of sweaty skin, wearing a black and red color matching compression training top without large logos, both arms extended forward as if just completing a change of direction; background is blurred gymnasium and audience light spots
centerpiece.scale: Character bust up to the knees, approximately 50% of the frame.

slogan.main: On the field, just score the next ball
slogan.sub: Just Do It · Spring Training Season 2026

logo_placement.position: Upper left corner with small hook-shaped icon and text, conforming to common proportions
logo_placement.size: Brand checkmark shape around 0.3 in height relative to the title text

aspect_ratio: 2:3 and 1:1 can be cropped, with the main subject centered during design

must_keep: Slogan Main Sentence Not Exceeding 12 Words, English Subtitle in One Line
Brand color can echo in the title or background lines but not overexposed
Character's dynamics have tension but with a natural posture.
avoid: Pixel-perfect replication of real event photos
Stuff Alliance and Third-Party Brand Logos in the Corners of the Image
Chinese characters use a decorative cursive font.
Deliberately close to the portrait details of any specific real athlete
